notes.title: 1.1 November Beta Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello again!

The Curse of Eternity Demo is still up for you to try. Please check it out and leave any feedback for us in our Discord: [url=Discord]https://discord.curseofeternity.com/[/url]

Today we're releasing a small update 1.1. Here are some of the changes that can be seen in the beta demo.

[h2][1.1] 11-11-22[/h2]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
 - Made the Docks boat even more impassable than before.
 - Smol fence doors / gates in the Docks.
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - Ship on main menu is no longer invisible
 - Some areas of the Docks no longer allows level breaks.
 - Fixed issue where colliders would become dissassociated with breakable boxes and the boxes would no longer be breakable anymore.
 - Fixed Docks colliders

notes.title: Curse of Eternity is in DREAMHACK BEYOND INDIE SHOWCASE! (& demo update 0.9!)
notes.content:
Hello!

Curse of Eternity will be part of Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase from 10/14 through 10/23! We want to do a live dev stream so subscribe and/or hop into our [url=https://discord.curseofeternity.com/]Discord[/url] to stay up to date on new announcements.

Also... we updated the demo to v0.9! (suck it, 0.8)
[h2][0.9] 10-7-22[/h2]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
 - Docks ship improvements
 - Favorites menu UX improvements
 - Misc. tutorial tweaks
 - Stamina and health bars are contextually shown more often
 - Rebalanced Thedros' Swapshield
 - Tutorials are permanently dismissed after being shown 3 times
 - Main menu gladiator pose tweaks
 - New loading screen images
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - Rock collider in Docks Caves

I'll post up as we iron out dates for live streams. Until then, have a nice day and hope to see you soon!

Thanks for checking out Curse of Eternity =)
Colton Ramos

tags.bug: - Rock collider in Docks Caves

notes.title: Curse of Eternity is in LATINX GAMES FESTIVAL! (& demo update!)
notes.content:
Hello!

Curse of Eternity will be part of [url=https://www.latinxgamesfestival.com/]LatinX Games Festival's[/url] Official Arcade Selection!

Check out the updated Curse of Eternity demo and so many other cool demos during this celebration of Latinx game development on Sept 25th, right here on Steam!

Also... we updated the demo to v0.7!
[h2][0.7] 9-13-22[/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
 - Added a new type of magic staff 
[h3]Changed[/h3]
 - Arrows, mage crystals, and shards of light are shown while the favorites wheel is opened.
 - Improved attack aim for melee attacks
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - Fixed issue where arrows would sometimes get caught on fences.

Want to say hello? Come chat with us in our [url=https://discord.curseofeternity.com/]Discord[/url]!

Thanks for checking out Curse of Eternity =)
Colton Ramos

notes.title: 0.6 June Beta Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello again!

The Curse of Eternity Demo is still up for you to try. Please check it out and leave any feedback for us in our Discord: [url=Discord]https://discord.curseofeternity.com/[/url]

Today we're releasing a small update 0.6. Here are some of the changes that can be seen in the beta demo.

[h2][0.6] 6-27-22[/h2]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
 - Use object animation no transitions back into itself when interacting with puzzles multiple times
 - Trinket sell price and shards to next level have been tweaked.
 - Damage has been tweaked when characters with much higher attack rating attack characters with much lower defense rating.
 - Shards level up curve has been tweaked
 - Wind lines are visible from further away
 - Numerous performance improvements
 - Reduced effectiveness of cursehand and frosted slows
[h3]Removed[/h3]
 - Removed Optimize Animators option
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - Enemy archers stay locked in place after nocking an arrow
 - Several lights have been optimized
 - Save data of the wrong type is now ignored when loading and checking if data is dirty
 - Enemy Acid Multishot no longer tracks the player as closely
 - Menu input is delayed when a menu is first opened, preventing user inputs from leaking into the menus from the main game.

notes.title: 0.4 March Beta Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello gang!

We're going to leave the Curse of Eternity beta demo up for people to continue to play after the recent Steam Next Fest ended. Please feel free to play the demo and drop any feedback into our [url=https://discord.curseofeternity.com/]Discord[/url]!

Today we're releasing an update 0.4. Here are some of the changes that can be seen in the beta demo.

[h2][0.4] 3-4-22[/h2]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
 - Archer enemies are more accurate
 - Increased mouse sensitivity setting range
 - Shard keeper no longer spawns for level one heroes
 - Fixed stair collider too far off of ground in Docks Shacks
 - Improved the way the stowed items toggle is shown in the inventory, sell, and upgrade menus.
 - Made lunge attack easier to trigger when attack button is hit before move forward is hit.
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - Made improvements to reliability of the display options in the options menu.
 - Fixed an issue where lock on would break when trying to lock on near Nida
 - Fixed an issue where hitting "view" on a newly picked up item while dialogue UI was open would cause a conflict

[h2][0.3] 2-28-2022[/h2]
[h3]Added[/h3]
 - New dashing drink consumable item
[h3]Changed[/h3]
 - Backtrack in Docks Caves is now shorter & more rewarding
 - Slowly stouter now caps out at 80 stacks
 - Black/Ear knights are now called "Fallen Knights"
 - Reduced likelihood of enemies circling the player
 - In lockpicking puzzles, pieces no longer have random traits they don't need (e.g. color or outline)
 - A hero's starting items and spells are favorited by default
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - Enemy ambushes no longer automatically die from falling damage
 - Performance issues in scenes with a lot of breakables
 - Nav mesh holes were filled in Echelon near the Fallen Knight
 - TutorialUI now waits for other UIs to close before prompt appears

notes.title: We Just Made a New Announcement Trailer!
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

We're still hard at work and are gearing up to get our demo ready for Steam Next Fest, 2022. In the meantime, check out our new trailer!

[previewyoutube=ztRGeoJzNtw;full][/previewyoutube]

Our new demo will feature a TON of updates since our last showing forever ago, including:
[list]
[*] All three playable character classes: Gladiator, Assassin, and Mage
[*] The Docks, an entire area of the game that includes several enemy variants and two new boss fights
[*] New puzzle chests & puzzle systems
[*] Weapon upgrade system
[*] Much more; dozens of misc. bugfixes and small updates
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230000/Curse_of_Eternity/]Hit that wishlist button[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1230000]follow our community channel[/url] for regular updates! We will post another announcement as Steam Next Fest approaches.

Want a chance to play the demo early and impart your wisdom upon our development process? [url=https://discord.curseofeternity.com/]Join our Discord[/url] and check the announcements section for info on how to sign up to be a beta tester.

Cheers & Happy Holidays!
Colton
Imakeda Games
